The project's settings, explained: view them and change one.

Usage:
  voidhash settings <command> [flags]

Commands:
  view       Show the project's settings: restored purchases, store sandbox, simulated purchases and
             ads.
  set        Change one setting.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash settings <command> --help' for more about a command.
